meta.name: Who Is America 720p
meta.description:
A satirical half-hour series from comedian Sacha Baron Cohen exploring the diverse individuals, from the infamous to the unknown across the political and cultural spectrum, who populate our unique nation.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 15 Jul 2018 · United States of America, United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: Showtime Networks, Four by Two Films, Spelthorne Community Television · Network: Showtime

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Comedian Sacha Baron Cohen explores the diverse individuals, from the infamous to the unknown across the political and cultural spectrum, who populate our unique nation. Series premiere.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Comedian Sacha Baron Cohen explores the diverse individuals, from the infamous to the unknown across the political and cultural spectrum, who populate our unique nation.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sacha Baron Cohen causing more satirical havoc as Erran Morad, interviews Roy Moore and trains three Trumpists to trap Mexicans. Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello talks with Chip Limehouse and 'Bone Crusher', and engages in an rap battle.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sacha presents four characters and deals with workplace security, pornography, yachts, Joe Arpaio and more.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Five characters tackle EDM, Trump's former campaign manager, a photo shoot, an unboxing vlog and various protection techniques.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sacha interviews Jill Stein, teaches defense to a wealthy couple, prepares three very special courses for a new restaurant and more.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sacha interviews former Democratic congressman Barney Frank; does an audition for going undercover at a liberal lesbian rally; and finishes the season with an interview with OJ Simpson.
